name: Network Service Decoy (SNMP / DNS)
description: Emulates SNMP and a log-only DNS server so device fingerprinting, community-string guessing and DNS reconnaissance are detected.

documentation.summary: The Network Service Decoy answers SNMP like a network device (system group only, and only for the configured community; wrong communities get silence, as on a real agent). It logs DNS queries, answering REFUSED and never resolving or forwarding, so it can't become an open resolver or leak internal names.

sections.title: Features
content: SNMP v1/v2c: records version, PDU, OIDs and the community string (HMAC'd). SET attempts are high severity.
SNMP v3: records the USM user name; no reply.
DNS: records the query name and type; zone transfer (AXFR) attempts are high severity. Responses are REFUSED and the same size as the query (no amplification).
Replies are rate-limited per source together with events, so spoofed traffic can't use the decoy as a reflector.

sections.title: Security Architecture
content: Global Sandbox Baseline: Enforced by the TrueSignal Hub. Drops ALL default Linux kernel capabilities and enforces a read-only filesystem.
Execution Privilege: Runs as container root (UID 0) strictly to bind UDP ports 53 and 161.
Data Handling: Captured passwords are HMAC-hashed by default with this node's Hub-derived key, so planted honeytokens are recognised; cleartext ('plain') is opt-in and should stay out of PCI scope.
Rate limiting: at most 20 events per source per minute; the rest are counted (suppressed_since_last), so a spray cannot flood the Hub or SIEM.

heuristics.recommendation_reason: SNMP or DNS services detected. Deploy the Network Service Decoy to catch infrastructure discovery.

env_vars.name: TS_HUB_ENDPOINT
env_vars.description: The URL of your central TrueSignal Hub.

env_vars.name: TS_SENSOR_ID
env_vars.description: Unique identifier for this specific trap.

env_vars.name: TS_SEVERITY
env_vars.description: Fallback alert severity (the sensor sets critical for logins, low for bare connections, medium for queries).

env_vars.name: TS_SERVICES
env_vars.description: Comma-separated UDP services to run, as proto:port (proto is snmp or dns). Do not reuse a port a real resolver or agent on this host uses.

env_vars.name: TS_SNMP_SYSDESCR
env_vars.default: Cisco IOS Software, C2960X Software (C2960X-UNIVERSALK9-M), Version 15.2(7)E8, RELEASE SOFTWARE (fc3)

env_vars.name: TS_SNMP_COMMUNITY
env_vars.description: The one community string the decoy answers (others get silence). Captured strings are HMAC'd either way.

env_vars.name: TS_CAPTURE_PASSWORDS
env_vars.description: How captured community strings are recorded: hash (default), plain or none.

env_vars.name: TS_CAPTURE_HASH_KEY
env_vars.description: Set by the Hub: this node's capture key (derived from the Hub's master key), so password HMACs can be matched against planted honeytokens. Any value set here is ignored.
